title: 第5章 山中遇险六叔归来第6章 沼泽得宝特殊灵符
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
当天晚上。
陈景安从府库里取了两张一阶灵符。
一张是“金甲符”
，两块灵石一张，运用灵力触发之后，可以在体表形成一层护体金甲。
以他目前的实力，若催动这样一张金甲符，足以抵挡那种没有法器的练气五层。
另一张是“火弹符”
，一块灵石一张，具体的效果取决于本身的境界，有一定的放大威力之效。
虽然这样讲话很不礼貌。
但陈景安还是得说，这两张符的价格够买他命了。
可转念一想，自己何尝不是变得更值钱了。
回到家之后。
他先将田契与转让契收好，又去哄着坐月子的岳姗，倒也不觉得疲倦。
这漫漫长夜孤苦。
陈景安看着娘俩的睡颜，感觉这日子充满了盼头。
次日一早。
他骑着“五角”
到了自己那块灵田所在山下，其实并不算多远。
这座山名为“松竹山”
，本来是一位县里财主专门搞来种松竹的。
但因为被陈家人发现了有灵田，于是就被强买了过来。

陈景安看着一眼望不到头的山路，觉得自己这是真的有了当山大王的潜质。
他将“金甲符”
贴在衣服里面，“火弹符”
攥在掌心，骑着妖马一路沿着山道巡视。
沿途瞧见了几只走兽，它们感知到妖马的气息，立刻就四散着逃走。
这也是区分妖物与凡兽最简单的办法。
陈景安的“五角”
虽然只是一匹妖四代，但怎么说也是妖物了，对凡兽还是有极大压制力的。
相反，要是妖马有了什么异样，这就代表山里有没处理干净的妖物。
那陈景安可就得求助长辈了。
他第一天没走得太深，感觉日头要落山了，就开始折返，因为天黑对自己不利。
按照计划，以这松竹山的大小，他起码得分三四天才能走完的样子。
这就像是解锁新地图一样。
可这不是游戏，他死了不能再来，因此陈景安不敢贪多。
这几天整个人连轴转，甚至就连最常去的“春欢楼”
都没去了。
那是清河县规模最大的一间青楼，去的人大多是县里有头有脸的。
content_en:
That night.
Chen Jingan took two first-level talismans from the treasury.
One is "Golden Armor Talisman"
, two spiritual stones in one. After being triggered by spiritual power, a layer of protective golden armor can be formed on the body surface.
With his current strength, if such a golden armor talisman is activated, it is enough to withstand the fifth level of Qi training without magic weapons.
The other one is "Fire Bullet Talisman"
, a piece of spiritual stone, the specific effect depends on its own realm, and it has a certain effect of amplifying the power.
Although it is very impolite to speak like this.
But Chen Jingan still had to say that the price of these two talismans was enough to buy his life.
But then I thought about it, why didn't I become more valuable?
After returning home.
He first put away the land deed and transfer deed, and then went to coax Yue Shan who was in confinement, but he didn't feel tired at all.
This long night of loneliness.
Chen Jing'an looked at his mother and daughter's sleeping faces and felt that this day was full of hope.
Early the next morning.
He rides "Five Points"
When we arrived at the foot of the mountain where our spiritual field was, it was actually not that far away.
This mountain is called "Songzhu Mountain"
, it was originally a wealthy man from the county who specially hired it to grow pine and bamboo trees.
But because the Chen family discovered that there was a spiritual field, they were forced to buy it.
Chen Jingan looked at the endless mountain road and felt that he really had the potential to become a mountain king.
He will use the "Golden Armor Talisman"
Stick it inside your clothes, "Fire Bullet Talisman"
Holding it in the palm of his hand, he rode the demon horse to patrol along the mountain road.
I saw several beasts along the way. They sensed the scent of the demon horse and immediately scattered and fled.
This is also the easiest way to distinguish monsters from ordinary beasts.
Chen Jingan’s “Five Corners”
Although it is only a fourth-generation demon, it is still a monster after all, and it still has great suppressive power over ordinary beasts.
On the contrary, if there is something strange about the monster horse, it means that there are monsters in the mountain that have not been dealt with cleanly.
Then Chen Jing'an will have to ask his elders for help.
He didn't go too deep on the first day. He felt that the sun was going to set, so he started to turn back because the darkness was not good for him.
According to the plan, given the size of Songzhu Mountain, it would take him at least three or four days to complete it.
It's like unlocking a new map.
But this is not a game. He can't come back if he dies, so Chen Jingan doesn't dare to be greedy.
In the past few days, everyone has been spinning around, even the most visited "Chunhuan Tower"
None of them went.
It was the largest brothel in Qinghe County, and most of the people who went there were well-known people in the county.
